name: Item Soft-Delete and Recovery -  Workspace recycle bin in UI
description: Item soft-delete and recovery offer a secure and efficient way to manage deleted items. When an item is deleted, it is moved to workspace recycle bin and retained for a defined retention period.  During this retention period, users can restore items or permanently remove them through UI.

result.nameEs: Eliminación temporal y recuperación de elementos: papelera del workspace en la interfaz
